DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor tendon avulsion at the distal phalanx).

The history of hyperextension while playing football, combined with your inability to flex the distal joint and the finger remaining extended at rest, is classic for this injury. The X-ray requested will confirm if there is an associated fracture.
